Metadata.title: Foldline
Metadata.description: Foldline is a free, private reading tracker for paper books, ebooks and audiobooks. Log progress your way, set goals only if you want them. No ads, no trackers, no streaks.
Metadata.ogAlt: Foldline: a free, private reading tracker. Mark your place, quietly.

Home.metaTitle: Foldline: a calm, private reading tracker
Home.eyebrow: A free reading tracker for everyone
Home.title: Mark your place, quietly.
Home.lead: Track every book you read on paper, on a screen or by ear. Log progress your way, set goals only if you want them, and keep it all to yourself. No feeds, no streaks, no pressure.
Home.ctaNote: Free. Private by default. No ads, ever.
Home.illustrationLabel: An open book with a ribbon bookmark and a folded page corner, its page gently turning

features.title: Everything a reader needs, nothing that nags
features.lead: Advanced tracking with as little friction as possible, wrapped in a shelf that feels like yours.

formats.title: Paper, ebook, audio
formats.body: Every format on one shelf. Switch mid-book from print to audiobook and your place comes with you.

units.title: Progress in any unit
units.body: Pages, percent, chapters, minutes or locations. Log it however your book counts.

goals.title: Goals, only if you want them
goals.body: Opt-in goals by year, month or your own range, with a warm little celebration when you get there. Falling behind is never a failure.

stats.title: Personal stats
stats.body: Pages, time, formats and pace, about you alone. Never compared with anyone, and hideable in one tap.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Your library is visible only to you. No public profile, no followers, nothing to perform.

ai.title: Thoughtful AI, later
ai.body: Helpful extras like summaries of your own notes, arriving later. Always opt-in, always explaining what they use.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Three small steps, then it quietly keeps your place.

signIn.title: Sign in with Google
signIn.body: One tap and your shelf is ready. No forms, no passwords to remember.

add.title: Add a book
add.body: Search by title, paste an ISBN, or add it by hand, even books with no ISBN at all.

log.title: Log progress your way
log.body: Note where you are whenever you like. Pause a book or let it go, both are perfectly fine.

ads.title: No ads
ads.body: Not now, not later. Your attention is yours.

trackers.title: No trackers
trackers.body: No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party scripts watching you read.

control.title: Your data, your call
control.body: Export everything or delete your account whenever you like.

free.a: Yes. Foldline is free for everyone, with no ads and no premium tier holding features back.

data.a: Only you. Your library is private by default and locked to your account. There are no public profiles or feeds.

formats.q: Does it work for audiobooks and ebooks?
formats.a: Yes. Track paper, ebook and audiobook, log progress in pages, percent, minutes or chapters, and switch formats mid-book.

stop.q: What if I stop reading a book?
stop.a: Pause it (we call it resting) or drop it. Both are normal, shame-free states, and nothing nags you about them.

google.a: It keeps sign-up to one tap and means we never store a password. Email sign-in is planned for later.

leave.q: Can I take my data with me?
leave.a: Always. Download all your data as a JSON file or delete your account from the Settings page, any time, in one click.

final.title: Your next chapter deserves a quiet place.
final.body: Start your shelf in a few seconds. It is free and stays private.

Footer.note: Made for slow evenings and good books.

Privacy.title: Privacy, in plain words
Privacy.lead: Foldline is private by default. Your reading is yours, and this page explains exactly what we keep, why, and how to take it with you or delete it.

who.title: Who runs Foldline
body: Foldline is a free reading tracker made and run by Istiak, an independent developer. When this policy says "we", it means Istiak.

collect.title: What we collect
body: When you sign in with Google, Google shares your email address, your name and your profile picture with us. We use them only to create your account and show you who you are signed in as.
Everything else is what you add yourself: the books you track, your progress, notes, goals and settings.
We do not ask Google for anything else, and we never see your Google password.

To keep Foldline safe from abuse, we briefly count requests per account and per network address. Addresses are stored only as a one-way keyed hash, never as the address itself, and are cleared within a day.

use.title: How we use it
body: Only to run Foldline for you: to keep your library, show your progress and your personal stats, and keep you signed in.
Your stats are about you alone. We never compare you with other readers.

never.title: What we never do
body: No ads. No product analytics, telemetry or third-party trackers, not even aggregate site analytics.
We never sell, rent or share your data with anyone for marketing, and we do not build a profile of you.
Nothing you add is public. Sharing, if it ever arrives, will be something you choose to do, one item at a time.

cookies.title: Cookies
body: Foldline sets only the cookies it needs to keep you signed in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies, so there is no cookie banner to click through.

where.title: Where your data lives
body: Your account and library are stored with Supabase, our database provider, in their Singapore region. The website is served by Vercel. Encrypted weekly backups are kept in a private GitHub repository for up to 90 days.
These providers process data only so Foldline can work. Each row of your data is locked to your account, so no other user can read it.

control.title: Your data, your call
body: You can download everything Foldline holds about you as a JSON file, and you can delete your account and all its data, both from the Settings page at any time. If anything goes wrong, email us and we will do it for you within 30 days.
After deletion, your data disappears from backups as they expire, within 90 days.

ai.title: AI features
body: Foldline has no AI features today. If we add any, they will be off by default, and each will explain what data it uses before you turn it on.

children.title: Children
body: Foldline is not meant for children under 13. If you believe a child has signed up, tell us and we will delete the account.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will update the date at the top and explain the change inside Foldline before it takes effect. We will never loosen these promises quietly.

Terms.title: Terms, kept short
Terms.lead: The simple rules for using Foldline. Written to be read, not skimmed past.

agreement.title: The agreement
body: By signing in to Foldline you agree to these terms and to our privacy policy. Foldline is made and run by Istiak ("we"). If you do not agree, please do not use Foldline.

service.title: What Foldline is
body: Foldline is a free, private reading tracker. We work hard to keep it running well, but it is provided as is, without guarantees that it will always be available or free of bugs.
Features may change as Foldline grows. We will not take away your ability to export your data.

account.title: Your account
body: You sign in with your Google account and are responsible for keeping it secure. You need to be at least 13 years old to use Foldline.
One person per account, please.

content.title: Your content stays yours
body: The books, notes and progress you add belong to you. You give us permission to store and process them only to run Foldline for you. We claim no other rights over them.

use.title: Fair use
body: Please do not misuse Foldline: no attempts to break in, overload or scrape the service, no access to other people's accounts, and nothing illegal.
We may suspend an account that seriously breaks these rules, and we will tell you why when we can.

leaving.title: Leaving
body: You can stop using Foldline at any time and ask us to delete your account and data. If Foldline ever shuts down, we will give you notice and time to export everything.

liability.title: Liability
body: Foldline is a free service. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses, lost data or damages arising from using it. Nothing here limits rights you have that cannot be limited by law.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
body: If we change these terms in a way that matters, we will update the date at the top and let you know inside Foldline before it takes effect.

account.title: Account
account.provider: You sign in with Google. Foldline never sees your password.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Download everything Foldline keeps about you as one JSON file. Take it anywhere, anytime.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This removes your account and everything in it: your library, progress, notes and settings. It cannot be undone, so download your data first if you want a copy.

Goodbye.body: Your account and all its data are gone. Backups age out within 90 days. Thank you for reading with Foldline, and happy reading, wherever your next book takes you.
